captions.linkedin:
The slowest part of tailoring resumes is starting over every time.

In QuickFit CV you upload your resume once and it becomes your profile: every role, line and skill, which you review once and can edit any time. Each new job then takes about 30 seconds.

One design choice I care about: every resume is a snapshot. Editing your profile later never changes a resume you've already sent, so you always know what a recruiter has.

Free to try: https://quickfitcv.com

#jobsearch #resume #careers
